# Trina AX

> Your company's own AI workspace: company files, reusable team skills and folder permissions.

Hosting enquiries and current $39/$69/$129 plans (USD before tax; AI usage separate): https://ax.trina.app/#pricing
Hosted in AWS Seoul. Self-hosted software is free; infrastructure and operations are separate.
Latest release: https://github.com/trina-app/trina-ax/releases/latest
Update feed: https://updates.trina.app (Linux server and office Mac).

Fresh teams allow shared subscriptions by default; saved choices persist. Eligible personal connections take priority; connection-level consent still applies. Software settings are not provider permission. Use only authorized accounts/plans.
Files/chats are stored on the server, but selected context goes to model providers. Server operators can read stored data. Revoked access does not retract earlier answers.

Browser/mobile web and Windows installer are available. No released Mac desktop DMG or app-store claim. Current source includes EN/KO/ID/JA/ES. HWP visual preview is experimental, off by default, excluded from default runtime bundles and unavailable on Debian 12; text extraction and original downloads remain. Check release notes for published-build availability. The local demo disables AI and is not a production installation.
